china_race_dynamics.text: Artificial Intelligence (AI) presents both a great opportunity for human advancement and a threat to humanity itself. Congress should work with technical experts, industry, and the public to determine what testing and oversight the most powerful systems necessitate. We can compete with China while taking seriously our responsibility to protect the safety of the American people.

deepseek.reason: The speaker says the US can compete with China while still meeting its responsibility to protect Americans' safety.
deepseek.confidence_reason: Explicit endorsement of competing with China coupled with a call for safety safeguards.

china_race_dynamics.text: The sanctions approach led by Treasury, Mr. Pottinger, I will ask you, would it catch a startup, for example, AI company, that is in its earlier stages just beginning to develop its technology may not even be on the radar other than with venture capital, would it catch and prevent them from developing civilian military technology?
china_race_dynamics.context: House hearing on legislation restricting U.S. outbound investment flowing to China's military sector.
